When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicles private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. description: Summit White and a straightforward Work Truck configuration give this 2022 Chevrolet Colorado a clean, practical character that fits buyers who want truck utility without unnecessary complexity. Powered by a V6 and an eight-speed automatic transmission, this rear-wheel-drive Colorado offers the bed space and upright driving position of a pickup while remaining easier to maneuver than a full-size truck. With about 92,900 miles, it is well suited for commuting, job-site use, home projects or everyday transportation around Wesley Chapel and Tampa Bay.  The V6 provides the stronger power option in the Colorado lineup and pairs with an eight-speed automatic transmission for smooth, familiar operation. Rear-wheel drive keeps the mechanical layout simple for Florida driving and avoids the added weight and hardware of a four-wheel-drive system for buyers who primarily stay on pavement. The midsize footprint is a major advantage in crowded parking lots, urban areas and residential neighborhoods where a full-size pickup can feel unnecessarily large.  The Work Truck trim is intentionally functional. Cloth seating and a durable cabin layout are appropriate for drivers who may use the truck for work, deliveries, equipment or regular hauling, while the controls remain simple and easy to reach. The bed provides a separate space for tools, supplies, landscaping materials, sporting equipment or anything else you would rather not carry inside the cabin. For contractors, small-business owners or homeowners, that flexibility can make a midsize pickup far more useful than a sedan or crossover.  At the same time, the Colorado remains comfortable enough to serve as a daily driver. The elevated seating position gives the driver a clear view in traffic, and the truck's narrower body makes it easier to place on busy Wesley Chapel roads or in tighter Tampa parking areas. Modern connectivity and convenience equipment help support phone use, audio and normal daily routines, while the cabin provides useful storage for smaller items that need to stay organized. This combination provides the balance of power and efficiency you need without compromise. The factory servicing completed by Route 23 Honda Factory Certified Technicians ensures this vehicle has been meticulously inspected and maintained to the highest standards.  Interior comfort is a priority in this Passport EX-L. Heated front bucket seats trimmed in premium leather provide warmth and support, while the power moonroof adds an open-air element to your drives. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps you and your passengers comfortable regardless of conditions, and the split-folding rear seat offers flexibility for both passengers and cargo.  Technology enhances your journey with seamless connectivity. The 215-Watt audio system with seven speakers delivers quality sound, while SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration puts your smartphone's capabilities at your fingertips through the vehicle's touchscreen interface.  Safety features provide confidence on every road. Lane Keeping Assist actively helps maintain your position in your lane, while the Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots. The rear parking camera gives you clear visibility when backing, and the comprehensive airbag system protects occupants. Electronic Stability Control and advanced braking systems work together to enhance vehicle control.
